name: Wong Po
source:
The former head of the Dark Tiger and general manager of the Media Asia Entertainment Group, an entertainment company in Macau.
He was planning to retire and move to Taiwan, so he was funneling part of his profits through the the Raksasa Party to a shell company in the Virgin Islands.
Prince exposed his plan and took over his position.
He then plans to have his son, Dark Cloud, take over the organization.
